thread:
Priya (CS): heads up — multiple customers in eu-west are seeing 503s and timeouts since ~10:34 UTC. High-level: upstream inference worker process crashed and the gateway returned 503s. Customers reporting streaming cutouts and retries piling up. escalating to eng/sre. :exclamation:
Ben (SRE): digging in. Alerts show upstream-runner restarted ~10:33:45 on pool gpu-pool-eu-2. OOM? svc logs show segfaults then container restart. Pulling recent logs now.
Zoe (ENG runtime): on it — looking at recent model swaps and kv-cache prefetch traces for that pool. Any pattern on model or payload size?
Priya (CS): most complaints are from long-context chat sessions (ctx ~150k tokens), several include tool-calls. One customer sent a sample request.
Marco (Support): sample request attached in ticket — large system + user messages, plus functions. Will paste minimal repro after triage.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-2437 -> priority P1 (503 spike: downstream customer impact). Pager duty routed to Ben.
Ben (SRE): quick snippets from runner stderr: ```
[2026-03-18T10:33:44Z] runtime: segfault at 0x7ffde724
[2026-03-18T10:33:44Z] signal 11 (SIGSEGV), code 1 (SEGV_MAPERR), fault addr 0x7ffde724
[2026-03-18T10:33:44Z] backtrace: libc.so.6+0x1a2b3
[2026-03-18T10:33:44Z] infer_runner(+0x4f1b2) [0x55a4b..]
[2026-03-18T10:33:44Z] --- coredump written ---
```
Zoe (ENG runtime): that backtrace points to libc symbol addresses; could be a memory corruption during kv prefetch + cuda memcpy. I'm seeing a bump in cudaMallocRetries and nvml mem usage right before crash.
Ben (SRE): heap profile shows a sudden surge in pinned GPU allocation from a streaming session right before segfault. Candidate: aggressive prefetch + large batch TTLing caused an out-of-bounds in our prefetch buffer.
Priya (CS): customers asking for ETA and mitigations. Any short-term fix?
Zoe (ENG runtime): immediate mitigation: enable fallback routing to smaller-capacity GPU pool and disable aggressive prefetch on affected pool. Rolling feature-flag now: "kv-prefetch=off" for gpu-pool-eu-2. Will also push a conservative quantization/alloc patch for the runtime.
Marco (Support): passing mitigation to customers: suggest retry with smaller context or pinned model variant, and we've temporarily disabled prefetch in the pool. Also offering to route traffic to dedicated pool as option.
Ben (SRE): applied affinity change at 10:45 UTC to drain heavy streams from gpu-pool-eu-2 -> gpu-pool-eu-1. Observed reduced crash rate but still seeing a couple restarts. Collecting coredumps.
Zoe (ENG runtime): repro steps I have so far: 1) stream request with ctx > 120k tokens and function/tool call enabled; 2) prefetch enabled; 3) concurrent batch resize to > 16 -> triggers pinned allocation surge. Repro locally with loadgen: ```
# repro script (simplified)
python loadgen.py --model redwood-large --context 130000 --prefetch true --concurrency 8
```
Ben (SRE): forensics: coredump shows heap metadata corrupted. Might be a race in our prefetch allocator under high concurrency. I'll open a debug branch and add ASAN-style checks to the allocator.
Priya (CS): summary for cs threads: mitigation in place (prefetch disabled, traffic drained); ETA for full fix?
Zoe (ENG runtime): patch ETA: hotfix to guard allocator + bounds checks -> testing now (10:55 UTC). If tests pass we'll roll to canary in next 45m and full rollout in ~2h.
Marco (Support): CS note drafted: explain root cause as allocator corruption under large streaming contexts, temporary mitigations (prefetch off + pool drain), and expected rollback timeline.
Ben (SRE): action items: collect all coredumps, mark impacted tenants, keep fallback routing for 3h, monitor error rate and latency tail.
Zoe (ENG runtime): PRACTICAL: adding a runtime flag to limit per-request pinned allocation to 8GB on the pool. Will set pool limit to avoid repeat.
Priya (CS): customers onboarded to dedicated pools — monitoring responses. One enterprise wanted extended logs; we'll provide coredump artifacts under NDA.
Ben (SRE): status check 11:15 UTC — error rate trending down from 14% -> 1.2% in eu-west. Keeping incident open until full rollout validated and 1h stable.
Zoe (ENG runtime): followups: full root cause writeup, unit tests for prefetch allocator, and backport to stable. Also will add telemetry for pinned allocations per-request.
Priya (CS): closing note: thanks team — CS will notify customers once fix rolled to stable. Marking this thread as primary incident log. :thumbsup:
